get_credit_balance.name: get_credit_balance
get_credit_balance.description: Get the authenticated user's Fish Audio plan, remaining package credits, and the per-call TTS text budget. Speech generation costs 1 credit per UTF-8 byte of text; transcription costs 500 credits per minute. Top up at https://fish.audio/go-premium/

list_my_workspaces.name: list_my_workspaces
list_my_workspaces.description: List the workspaces of the team this connection is authorized for.

list_media_models.name: list_media_models
list_media_models.description: List available Fish image and video models (video includes lip sync and talking avatars). Capabilities are named as in the Fish web app, e.g. t2i (text-to-image), edit (image edit), upscale, t2v (text-to-video), i2v (image-to-video), first_last, reference, reference_video, video_audio (lip sync), avatar_audio (talking avatar). default_credits is the price of one output with default parameters; capabilities billed by input length report credits_per_input_second instead, with input_seconds_rounding: ceil where every started second is billed.

get_media_model.name: get_media_model
get_media_model.description: Get one media model's prompt policy and, per capability, its parameter schema, required_roles and accepted inputs (kind, mime_types, max_bytes, max_count, dimension limits). Call it once per model and keep the result for the whole conversation; call it again only after an invalid_arguments error. Accepted inputs can also be a finished generation result's media.object_key.

create_media_upload.name: create_media_upload
create_media_upload.description: Create a one-hour workspace-scoped upload slot for an image, video or audio input, only for a file that is not in Fish yet. To reuse a finished generation result as an input, pass its media.object_key to the estimate and generate tools instead; do not download a result and upload it again. When the user will upload through web_upload_url, ask which format the file is (for example png, jpg, webp, mp4, mov, mp3 or wav) before calling this tool and use that extension in file_name: the link only accepts files of that format. For web_upload_url file_size need not be exact (the page re-signs the slot for the real size); when you PUT to upload_url yourself, file_size must be the exact byte size.

estimate_video_generation.name: estimate_video_generation
estimate_video_generation.description: Estimate video generation cost (text/image/reference-to-video, lip sync, talking avatar) and validate the request. Pass operation, or inputs with roles and let the capability follow from them. This is read-only and creates no task or quote.

prompt.description: Required unless get_media_model reports prompt optional; ignored when it reports unsupported.

inputs.description: Input media, each with its role, in order. The capability follows from the roles given, as in the Fish web app (get_media_model lists each capability's required_roles and accepted inputs), e.g. startFrame → i2v, ref → reference, videoRef/audioRef → reference video/audio, sourceVideo + sourceAudio → lip sync, ref + sourceAudio → talking avatar. object_key is the media.object_key of a finished generation result in the same workspace (use it directly, no upload needed) or comes from create_media_upload for a file that is not in Fish yet.

input_object_key.description: Shorthand for a single input: requires operation and fills that capability's first required role (e.g. startFrame for i2v). object_key from create_media_upload, or the object_key of a finished generation result in the same workspace.

operation.description: Capability name from get_media_model (t2v, i2v, reference, video_audio, ...). Required without inputs; with inputs it is optional and pins the capability.

generate_video.name: generate_video
generate_video.title: Generate Video — Charges Credits
generate_video.description: Submit a video generation with the same parameters used for estimation. The API revalidates price before charging credits.

get_generation_status.name: get_generation_status
get_generation_status.description: Poll media status and billing; this may reconcile provider state and credits. While running it returns poll_after_seconds (about 20 for images, 60 for videos): wait that long before calling again. Once finished it also returns the results, so get_generation_result is not needed. Pass generation_id for one generation, or generation_ids (up to 20) to check several at once.

generation_ids.description: Check several generations in one call instead of generation_id; list only the ones still running.

get_generation_result.name: get_generation_result
get_generation_result.description: Get terminal media results and billing; this may reconcile provider state. A finished get_generation_status returns the same results. A result's media.object_key can be passed directly as an input to image edit or video generation in the same workspace.
